evidence: The reporter supplies a 0.102.3001 diagnostic archive and Windows 26H2 build details.
The archive includes an Application Error event for PowerToys.Settings.exe with Microsoft.UI.Xaml.dll and exception c000027b.
The PowerAccent event file is empty and the captured settings have Quick Accent disabled. This does not prove that Quick Accent is healthy in every session.
Runner logs contain QuickAccessHost::start calls, but a start call alone is not proof of successful UI activation.
judgment.rationale: Do not equate QuickAccess with Quick Accent or treat the native XAML crash code as a root cause. The next discriminator is the exact failing surface and opening sequence, not another copy of the same ZIP or an unrelated reinstall recommendation.

title: "(Some of PowerToys services/apps) have stopped working"

comment.body:
Thanks for the supplied archive and Windows build. It contains a Settings/XAML crash event, while the Quick Accent crash-event file is empty; Quick Access and Quick Accent are different features. Please provide:
1. A screenshot of the exact stopped-working message through the GitHub web UI, with sensitive content hidden, naming the surface that fails.
2. The short sequence immediately before it. In particular, say whether Settings and the tray Quick Access menu fail independently after starting PowerToys.

This will identify the activation path to reproduce rather than guessing from the feature name.

fix_assessment.rationale: Do not equate QuickAccess with Quick Accent or treat the native XAML crash code as a root cause. The next discriminator is the exact failing surface and opening sequence, not another copy of the same ZIP or an unrelated reinstall recommendation.

issue_context.analysis: Do not equate QuickAccess with Quick Accent or treat the native XAML crash code as a root cause. The next discriminator is the exact failing surface and opening sequence, not another copy of the same ZIP or an unrelated reinstall recommendation.

information_gaps.why_needed: Distinguish a Settings window crash, tray Quick Access failure and Quick Accent activation failure
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Upload a screenshot of the message through the GitHub web UI with sensitive content hidden, and state which surface failed.
information_gaps.information: The exact failing UI surface and complete visible error

information_gaps.why_needed: Correlate the Settings event with automatic startup versus a tray/Settings/Quick Accent action
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Give short numbered steps after starting PowerToys and say whether opening Settings and the tray Quick Access menu fail independently.
information_gaps.information: The sequence immediately before the failure

initial_investigation: Read the report, all current comments, labels, assignees and linked-work timeline; checked for existing coverage before proposing work.

Inspected runner/module startup logs, captured enablement, Settings and PowerAccent Application Error records, and QuickAccessHost startup/error boundaries; did not copy private account paths from the archive.
Reassessed the complete current issue discussion and timeline, including the latest maintainer labels. Label changes alone do not satisfy unanswered evidence requests or prove a repair.
inferences: An unhandled Settings/XAML initialization or activation failure is a candidate for the opening symptom; the archive does not identify its originating XAML exception or establish a Quick Accent defect.
issue_context.summary: The supplied startup archive contains a Settings/XAML crash; the report also ambiguously names Quick Accent and QuickAccess.

plan: Correlate the supplied Settings crash event with the reporter's exact opening sequence and reproduce that surface on the reported build.
Capture the originating XAML/managed exception under a debugger, identify its initialization/resource/control path and repair that demonstrated failure rather than suppressing all startup exceptions.
Add a regression for the identified opening path and verify independent Settings, tray Quick Access and enabled Quick Accent activation.
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: a Settings/XAML activation exception aborts the requested surface; the underlying exception and relationship to Quick Access are not yet identified.

confidence.rationale: There is a concrete Settings event, but no causal stack or unambiguous failing-surface sequence. This is an investigation proposal, not an implementation-ready fix or claim of a Quick Accent root cause.

proposed_fixes.title: Identify and repair the failing Settings activation path
verification: The confirmed opening sequence no longer crashes; the diagnostic error is observable if startup fails, and unrelated disabled modules are not misreported as broken.
